buildAdaptations: Install limited to @dtc/backend (storefront not installed); pnpm store and corepack home on the bind-mounted checkout (.xtrace-*, git-excluded). No source file modified; `medusa build` is not used (admin UI not built).
configAdaptations: Run with `medusa start` in NODE_ENV=development straight from the starter's TypeScript sources; env only: DATABASE_URL (private PostgreSQL container), HOST=0.0.0.0, PORT=9000, JWT_SECRET/COOKIE_SECRET (random per run), CORS vars from .env.template, MEDUSA_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, DO_NOT_TRACK=1. apps/backend/medusa-config.ts and instrumentation.ts are unmodified.

run.entrypointDocker: cd apps/backend && node ./node_modules/@medusajs/cli/cli.js db:migrate && cli.js user -e $ADMIN_EMAIL -p $ADMIN_PASSWORD && exec node ./node_modules/@medusajs/cli/cli.js start
run.note: `medusa develop` forks `medusa start` as a child process (develop.ts fork()); the instrumented run should launch `start` directly so the traced process is the server.

expectedSeams: outcome 401, no DB statement for the resource
validateAndTransformBody middleware (zod strict) rejects before the workflow
pg INSERT product/product_option/... in a transaction
GET /admin/products/{id} and list -> query graph -> pg SELECT
POST /admin/products route -> createProductsWorkflow -> Product module detects existing handle (unique constraint) -> error mapped by Medusa error handler (HTTP 400)
pg lookup/INSERT attempt rolled back; no new row
POST /admin/sales-channels, POST /admin/api-keys, POST /admin/api-keys/{id}/sales-channels (Sales Channel + API Key modules + link)
GET /store/products with x-publishable-api-key (publishable-key middleware + sales channel filtering) -> pg SELECT with joins

6 concurrent POST /admin/products + 18 concurrent GET /admin/products/{id}; each recording contains only its own product id/handle and its own pg INSERT/SELECT (no cross association between interleaved workflows/transactions)
DELETE /admin/products/{id} -> deleteProductsWorkflow -> soft delete (pg UPDATE deleted_at)
express root with no matching route (Medusa not-found handler)
body-parser failure on malformed JSON -> 4xx via Medusa error handler

knownLimits: Admin dashboard, storefront, workers (`--workers`/`--servers` cluster modes) not exercised; `medusa develop` mode not exercised.
Starter commit is an immutable SHA but its dependencies resolve from the registry via pnpm-lock.yaml integrity hashes.
Upstream test suites were not run.

instrumented.status: NOT RUN (preparation only). Documented for the later packaged-candidate run.
instrumented.xtraceVersionAtPreparation: slice/v001-node-capture 09aba20 provides only the node:http server request root (adapters/node/packages/adapter-core/src/http-capture.cts); Express/Nest/Fastify framework modules and DB-driver seams required by ADR 0005 are not present on that branch, so only the HTTP-root assertions below are currently satisfiable; the framework/DB rows become required as those modules land.
procedure: 1. node harness/run.mjs prepare|create+build (once) -> immutable pinned workspace.

2. Start PostgreSQL (or seed SQLite) fresh exactly as in the baseline (harness reset), then launch the app with the packaged `xtrace` as the process launcher inside the same linux/arm64 Docker image (or on the host with the same Node major) instead of plain `node`.
3. Run the same scenarios (same harness code, same request bodies); compare each scenario's semanticEffectFingerprint with baseline-<n>/scenarios.json; any difference fails the scenario.

4. Query X-trace (CLI/API/browser) for the recording of each request and assert handler/intermediate/DB/outcome rows listed in `scenarios[].expectedSeams`, with wrong-association checks for `concurrent-writes-and-reads` (every recording holds only its own route params, response and DB statements).

5. Stop/restart X-trace, reopen persisted captures in the packaged browser; privacy canaries (synthetic secrets in request bodies, headers, cookies, DB values) must not appear in wire/logs/storage/API/exports/diagnostics; measure overhead (baseline vs instrumented p50/p95 and throughput over repeated runs).
instrumented.launcher: xtrace run -- node ./node_modules/@medusajs/cli/cli.js start   (cwd apps/backend; direct node entry preferred over `pnpm exec medusa`/npm scripts so xtrace supervises the server process; if a package-manager script launcher is used, `xtrace run -- pnpm start` must propagate the instrumentation env to the node child). `medusa develop` re-forks `start` with IPC, so it is a launcher-propagation test, not the primary path. Admin-user and migration commands (`cli.js db:migrate`, `cli.js user`) run uninstrumented before the traced server starts.

seamsByLayer.express: Express 4.22.2 route templates from file-based routes (e.g. /admin/products/:id), middleware order (authenticate, validateAndTransformBody/Query, publishable-key), error handler (required by ADR 0005 'Express/Node HTTP')
seamsByLayer.nest: none (no NestJS in Medusa 2.21.2); claims limited to observed seams
seamsByLayer.intermediateApplicationCall: route handler + workflow step functions / module service methods in @medusajs/medusa and core modules (dist/api/**/route.js, product/api-key/sales-channel module services)
seamsByLayer.db: MikroORM -> knex -> pg Client.query (SQL text sanitized, binds excluded by default)
seamsByLayer.outcome: HTTP status + error type from Medusa error handler

notes: The starter ships apps/backend/instrumentation.ts; Medusa's start command imports it via registerInstrumentation(). X-trace must coexist with (or be unaffected by) that hook: it is unmodified here.

ledger.receiptShape: tools/release/check_ledger.py (slice/v001-control-admission) validate_receipt/_validate_special: schemaVersion 1; requirementId; result 'passed'; candidateSha == exact candidate; build{id,sourceSha,artifactSetSha256} bound to the accepted logical release build; artifacts[] {path,sha256} (packaged xtrace artifacts in the accepted set); evidence[] {path,sha256}; checks[] each {status:'passed', reached:true}; kind 'campaign'; attestation{upstream{canonicalUrl (https), sha (40-hex), stableTag}, scenarios[>=5]{name, baseline{path,sha256}, instrumented{path,sha256}, browser{path,sha256}, privacy{path,sha256}, overhead{path,sha256}, semanticEffectFingerprint (64-hex) == instrumentedSemanticEffectFingerprint}, artifacts[]}; signatures[] containing a trusted 'campaign-runner' role signature.
ledger.fromThisPreparation: baseline-<n>/scenario-index.json (written by lib/export-scenarios.mjs) supplies, per scenario, name, baseline{path,sha256} and the 64-hex semanticEffectFingerprint; the instrumented run must reproduce each fingerprint exactly and write instrumentedSemanticEffectFingerprint, instrumented/browser/privacy/overhead evidence files. Skipped, unreached or synthetic assertions never count.

outbound.statement: not present in the pinned stack without custom code
evidence: packages/core/utils/src/common/define-config.ts @020565398e: default providers are local/manual only: fulfillment '@medusajs/medusa/fulfillment-manual' (L329), notification '@medusajs/medusa/notification-local' (L340, logs only), file '@medusajs/medusa/file-local' (L384, disk), search '@medusajs/medusa/search-postgres' (L360), auth emailpass; the s3 file provider (L400) is only added when S3 env is set.
Event bus, cache and locking default to in-memory modules unless REDIS_URL is set (L374-377, redisUrl not found -> fake redis in app.log).

The Payment module is registered without any provider in the starter's medusa-config.ts (no stripe); packages/modules/providers/{payment-stripe,notification-sendgrid,analytics-posthog,file-s3,auth-github|google|oidc} exist but are opt-in and need external services/credentials.
Telemetry (@medusajs/telemetry) is the only default network egress and is disabled with MEDUSA_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1.
